[EN] Finish What You Started
[ES] Termina lo que empezaste
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'm so close to finishing my weapon.
[ES] Estoy muy cerca de terminar mi arma.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Relax. I can find it for you.
[ES] Relájate. Puedo encontrarlo por ti.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Look for {@LinkCreature:250#1001} underground in Viridian Caverns.
[ES] Busca a {@LinkCreature:250#1001} bajo tierra en Viridian Caverns.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "This sap smells terrible."
[ES] "Esta savia huele terrible."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect the sap from the rati tree in the Viridian Caverns.
[ES] Recoge la savia del árbol rati en Viridian Caverns.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Rati Tree Sap
[ES] Savia de árbol rati
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the sap to {@LinkCreature:250#1001} in Viridian Caverns.
[ES] Entrega la savia a {@LinkCreature:250#1001} en Viridian Caverns.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Return in triumph, young aman!"
[ES] "¡Regresa en triunfo, joven aman!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
